zh-CN:
更新内容
• 侧栏新增独立文件夹浏览页：左侧目录树、右侧歌曲列表，可拖动分隔条调整宽度，支持逐级展开、键盘导航，并在再次进入时恢复上次目录
• 目录树展开与收起带平滑过渡，浏览大目录更流畅
• 排序新增按发行年份升序/降序，缺少年份的曲目固定排在末尾
• 首页推荐批次现在会跨启动保留，最近展示过的歌曲自动降权并在 7 天后过期，「换一批」重复更少
• 设置页分区改为按需加载，只创建当前分区；字体列表按界面语言显示本地化字体名
• 全局按钮新增 Fluent 悬停上浮与按压缩放动效；云母与亚克力默认外观对齐 WinUI，云母更透明
• 修复双击歌曲列表可能播放错误曲目，以及动画缓存长期占用图形资源导致的内存增长
• 更新隐私政策，补充 Windows 错误报告诊断信息说明；协议版本变更，下次启动需重新确认
en:
Release Notes
• New standalone folder browser in the sidebar: a directory tree on the left and the selected folder's songs on the right, with a draggable splitter, expandable folders, keyboard navigation and the last folder restored when you return
• The folder tree now expands and collapses with smooth transitions, keeping large folders responsive
• Added release-year sorting (ascending and descending); tracks without a year always sort last
• Home recommendation batches now persist across restarts; recently shown tracks are down-weighted and expire after 7 days, so "another batch" repeats less
• Settings sections now load on demand, creating only the active section; font names follow the UI language
• Added Fluent hover-lift and press-scale animations to buttons; Mica and Acrylic defaults now match WinUI, with a more transparent Mica
• Fixed double-clicking a song sometimes playing the wrong track, and animation caches holding graphics resources and increasing memory use
• Updated the privacy policy with details about Windows Error Reporting diagnostics; the agreement version changed and will be shown again on next launch
